爱莎贝儿-151CM-L 粉肤 RAD013 佐仓穗乃花Sakura Honoka-只属于你的猫
她踮起脚想逃走，却被他一把拉回怀里。
猫耳被他轻轻揉着，她脸红到耳根，心跳快得像要融化。
他贴着她耳边说：“从今天起，你只准对我心跳。”她终于放下抵抗，主动把唇送了上去。
身型：151CM-L 粉肤

Elsa Babe-151CM-L Pink RAD013 Sakura Honoka-Your Only Cat
She tiptoed, trying to escape, but he pulled her back into his arms.
His cat ears were gently rubbed, her face flushed to her ears, her heart pounding as if it were melting.
He whispered in her ear, "From today onwards, you're only allowed to have your heart beat for me." She finally let go of her resistance and offered her lips.
Body Type: 151CM-L with Pink skin tone.
